Fig. 10. Sequential frames from integrated planetary exploration mission simulation in Isaac Lab in a single run. The color of the dots represents the task-specific policy used at that instance in the simulation. The robot successfully navigates rough terrain, jumping over a 2.1 m wide crater, executes a 3.5 m forward jump from a 1.1 m ledge, performs a 2.6 m vertical reconnaissance jump, and clears a 1.1 m ledge during a forward jump. The attitude control policy maintains the desired orientation during all flight phases to ensure safe landings. Model of Mars terrain from https://sketchfab.com/gaiastucky
